description: This file defines models and a fetcher for retrieving historical EPS data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including query parameter classes, data models, and an asynchronous fetcher class.

classes.name: FMPHistoricalEpsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching historical EPS data from FMP, including a limit option.

classes.name: FMPHistoricalEpsData
classes.description: Represents the EPS data retrieved from FMP, including actual and estimated revenue and last update date.

classes.name: FMPHistoricalEpsFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous fetcher class for retrieving and transforming historical EPS data from FMP API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an FMPHistoricalEpsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches EPS data for specified symbols from the FMP API, with optional limit and credentials.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into a list of FMPHistoricalEpsData instances.
